replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Blitz, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you use more block variations to make the map look more unique instead of having only clay blocks. You should also make the map more bigger and expand the islands, make more islands, and have less void. You should also change the monument positions and not make the 2 team color monuments together.


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You may resubmit your map once edited.

replies.author: Howsie
replies.body:
I feel like you're ignoring the key points to my argument. Let me dot point them simply so you can reply to each one.

- Changing the titles to ticks and crosses is spammy and draws unnecessary amounts of attention to it. It also labels a piece of work is good or rubbish. 

- Replying to each post consecutively is spamming up the forums. Imagine if you did this in bulk

- These are showcases for discussion. They look for feedback not a default, almost automated response from the high and mighty 'map developers' 

Now how I would change it:- 
- Google doc with discussion
- Let the community discuss the maps with its pros and cons. (Community including the useless 'map developer' rank)
- If you want to implement it, contact them, dont label the map accepted or denied. They're not applications
- And if you are considering them as applications, then thats dumb and needs to change
